nonBlockingIssues.description: Extra enum case ISHInstrumentationEventSessionBootstrapDeferred not in original specification. Method signatures for beginInterval/endInterval include extra 'attributes:' parameter not explicitly specified.

ish_instrumentation_record_event ignores the event_name parameter (documented as minimal implementation). ish_instrumentation_end_interval passes empty string for interval name (acceptable given current interface design).
In endInterval:, signpostID is set to OS_SIGNPOST_ID_NULL with a comment noting a full implementation would look up the stored ID. This is acceptable as a known limitation.
